description.value: Hong Kong Restaurant is a Revelstoke institution, serving authentic Cantonese cuisine continuously since 1981 and now a recognized stop for both locals and touring visitors. The restaurant offers dine-in service including a popular weekend dinner buffet with 18-plus hot items, as well as a full takeout menu. It has formal partnerships with travel agencies and regularly hosts large tourist groups passing through Revelstoke.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for hongkongrestaurant.ca is live and corroborates the OSM address (113 MacKenzie Ave, Revelstoke, BC) and supplies a phone number not present in OSM. Takeout is confirmed by the dedicated 'Takeout Menu' page and review mentions of 'great take-out'. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (250) 837-2360 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established restaurant in Revelstoke with an active website and confirmed address. Useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a full meal or takeout.

wow_evidence: Revelstoke institution, serving authentic Cantonese cuisine continuously since 1981... formal partnerships with travel agencies and regularly hosts large tourist groups
